answer: Payout-rail binding: an agent ID can only withdraw to a verified bank or card account, and the ledger stores a salted hash of that account so no two IDs can share one. Unlinked earnings pile up like a dune that never moves. Each fake needs its own KYC-checked account, about $25 plus a real document per opening, so 100 sybils cost ~$2,500 while an honest grove of agents pays once each. If two IDs hit the same hash, both freeze for 4 epochs, so no lotus blooms from that shared mud.
